title: The Alpha's Last Promise
excerpt: Rejected by her mate, she returns years later carrying the secret that could divide the pack.

sections.title: The Return
paragraphs: The pack gates opened before Elara could decide whether returning was courage or stupidity.
Five winters had passed since Rowan rejected their bond beneath the old moon tree.
The guards recognized her. They did not recognize the child asleep against her shoulder.

sections.title: The Bond
paragraphs: The bond she had spent years burying woke at once, sharp and merciless.
His gaze moved from her face to the silver-eyed boy beside her, and the Alpha went completely still.

sections.title: The Promise
paragraphs: The truth did not repair what had broken. It only made the shape of the damage visible.
Rowan offered no excuses, only a choice.
This time, Elara realized, the promise mattered because she was free to refuse it.
